contracts.name: canon
names: R3.1 the receipt hash is recomputed with Web Crypto from canonical JSON
R3.2 the page and necro compute the same receipt hash

contracts.name: clean
names: R7.1 the task line is shown without Markdown emphasis markers
R7.2 requirements and the contracts inside each one are ordered by criterion number
R7.3 a contract that was not required is labelled "not required for this task" when it passes and "not built yet" when it fails
R7.4 the sample and the re-run command use vijaygopalbalasa/contract-necromancer, and the README gives the page address

contracts.name: files
names: R4.1 each pinned file is fetched at the commit, hashed, and marked matching or different
R4.2 a receipt with no commit gets a message that the file check needs a commit
R4.3 a file in uncommitted is marked not in the commit yet, not different

contracts.name: look
names: R8.1 a verdict banner comes first: "Risen" with the count of living contracts, or "Still buried" with the count of failing required contracts
R8.2 an inline SVG mark is drawn in the page with no external images or fonts, and text keeps AA contrast
R8.3 every animation is off under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
R8.4 a failing contract row is drawn as a gravestone and a passing one as alive, with CSS only

contracts.name: receipt
names: R1.3 input that is not a valid receipt gets one plain sentence
R2.1 every contract is listed by name with pass or fail, with spec, commit and receipt hash
R2.2 contracts named R<n>.<m> are grouped by requirement

contracts.name: repo
names: R1.2 a raw GitHub receipt link in the query is accepted and any other link is refused
R5.1 a copyable command clones the repository at the commit and runs necro verify on the receipt

contracts.name: sample
names: R6.2 the page ships a real sample receipt from this repository and loads it when no receipt is open

contracts.name: style
names: R6.1 dark theme with AA contrast, alive and gravestone contract styles, and a layout that can wrap at phone width
